name: Judah
description: Power-ups! Kill 10 enemies to get a speed boost or rapid fire!

name: June
description: Roadblocks! Lose a heart and one appears — touch it again and ouch!

name: Judah
description: Boss fight! Survive 60 seconds and a giant boss appears — kill it to win!

name: June
description: Timer is now 15 seconds — boss fight starts fast!

name: Rebecca
description: Pasture mode! Lure 8 bears into the pen — but avoid the danger zone!

name: A Kid
description: No timer! Fill the BEAR ZONE to summon the boss — but stay too long and lose a heart!

name: Ben
description: Press B for an AIRSTRIKE — jets fly over and drop bouncing chickens that hurt everything!

name: Ben
description: The bears are now ENORMOUS stomping giants!

name: Zeke
description: RACE! Run through 15 maps faster than Soup the dog — beat them all to fight the boss!

name: Gabi
description: Bears follow you between maps! Each map has a unique design! Boss bounces back when it hits you! Huge slow shots!

name: Papi
description: Super Mario Bros overworld theme plays in 8-bit square wave while you play!

name: Zeke
description: Hippo boss! You're a kid! Press X to cartwheel — spins all bears forward! Bears drop hearts!

name: Papi
description: Wordle in the middle of the arena! Type letters while dodging bears — Tab to submit. Auto-resets after each round.

name: Arin
description: Silence! The music is off — just the sounds of battle.

name: Soup
description: Little cyclones spin across the arena — touch one and you get pulled into a whirling orbit!
